name: banglish_bench
description:
BanglishBench — Standardized Evaluation for Banglish Language Models
	

No standardized way to evaluate Banglish models existed — until now. BanglishBench is the first evaluation benchmark for Banglish (phonetic Bengali written in Latin script): 450 hand-crafted prompts, 9 categories, automated scoring, one command.

v2.0 released — Translation category removed (companion model, not translator). Added relevance scoring for honest evaluation. Updated leaderboard with v1 vs v2 scores.… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/sifat-febo/banglish_bench.
reputation: First standardized benchmark for Banglish with an emerging leaderboard and growing adoption among Bangla NLP researchers.
